title: Test FSDIR backend fsdir_sign/verify/decrypt crypto ops
description: src/wp11_backend_fsdir.c implements fsdir_sign, fsdir_verify, fsdir_decrypt as real wolfCrypt operations, but they have zero test coverage. wp11_test_fsdir.c only tests slot detection and login/logout with empty keystores. Need a new test file (test/wp11_test_backend_fsdir.c) following the pattern of wp11_test_backend_soft.c: create .p11k keystore with real ECC/RSA key DER, build wp11_key_handle_t with priv=wp11_key_entry_t*, call wp11_backend_fsdir_ops.sign/verify/decrypt directly, verify output with independent wolfCrypt oracle.
